$800 up to 4 hours

Solo wedding DJ and MC serving Dallas, Plano, Frisco, McKinney, Rockwall, and nearby cities. The standard package includes sound, ceremony and reception planning tools, dance-floor lighting, and a lapel mic.

The standard package is $800 for up to 4 hours, including sales tax. Extra time is $100 per hour. A $200 deposit holds the date, and the balance is due 7 days before the event. · Source · checked 2026-10-03 · published
